attchmntText: Karma Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Karma Energy Limited has published its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The publication occurred on November 13, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express in English and Mumbai Lakshadeep in Marathi. This filing is in compliance with Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The notice was submitted by Chetan D. Mehra, Managing Director, with DIN 00022021. The company symbol is KARMAENG.

attchmntText: Karma Energy Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Karma Energy Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board unanimously approved the unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 265.22 Lac for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the profit after tax was 309.28 Lac. Revenue from operations stood at 559.26 Lac for the quarter and 879.63 Lac for the half year. Earnings per share were 2.29 Rupees for the quarter and 2.67 Rupees for the half year. The statutory auditors, Batliboi & Purohit, issued an unmodified review report on these results. The meeting commenced at 15.45 hours and concluded at 16.10 hours.
